title: Friend sees a portal open in the sky and saucers fly out

tellings.quote: a portal open up in the sky and saucers fly out of it like what my friend saw. My my friend saw this actually happen

plain: A man is said to have watched a portal open up in the sky and saucers fly out of it. The filmmaker Tim Alberino tells this about a friend of his, and says, "my friend saw this actually happen." He gives no time or place.
